Labyrinth

Holly Mingo, 2024

Electric blue lines drawn and redrawn across a black ground until they become a maze you can lose yourself in. Holly works without a plan, letting the painting find its own structure.

A large, square canvas with real presence: it changes as you move around it and as the light in the room changes.

Acrylic on canvas, 100 × 100 cm.

rich-simmons:
Featured work

Peace Not War Blonde

Rich Simmons

Hand-cut stencils, spray paint and gold leaf: Rich Simmons takes the language of comic books and street art and builds it up, layer by layer, into a luxury pop portrait.

A self-taught British artist who moved from the street to galleries across Europe and North America, he keeps the punk spirit and adds the polish.

Spray paint and gold leaf on deep-edge canvas, 122 × 91 cm.
